```{r}
read_quantification <- function(dir_name) {
  csv_files <- Sys.glob(file.path(dir_name,"*.csv"))
  dt_list <- lapply(csv_files, data.table::fread)
  df <- tibble(path = csv_files,
               feature_values = dt_list) %>%
    mutate(dir_name = dir_name,
           file_name = basename(path),
           feature_values = purrr::map(feature_values,tibble)) %>%
    separate(file_name,into = c("well_name","ch1","ch2","ch3","ch4","sample","id"),sep="[,_.]", extra = "drop") %>%
    mutate(well_name = str_replace(well_name, "^Well", ""),
           field_id = as.integer(id))
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
data_dir_images <- "/srv/scratch/berrylab/z3536241/NikonSpinningDisk/260515_mACPOLR2A_CRC_EU/20260519_171947_338/"
data_dir_quant <- "/srv/scratch/berrylab/z3532965/NikonSpinningDisk/260515_mACPOLR2A_CRC_EU/20260519_171947_338/"
plate_layout_file <- "/srv/scratch/z3532965/src/blana/Alex/260515_mACPOLR2A_CRC_EU/260515_mACPOLR2A_CRC_EU.csv"

# Read plate layout
plate_layout <- read_csv(plate_layout_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(well_name=WELL)

# Read and process quantification data
f <- read_quantification(file.path(data_dir_quant, "QUANTIFICATION")) %>%
     dplyr::mutate(data_dir = dirname(dirname(path))) %>%
     dplyr::select(-c(ch1, ch2, ch3, ch4, sample))

# Process metadata
m <- tibble(data_dir = data_dir_images) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(image_dir = purrr::map_chr(data_dir_images, ~file.path(.,"OME-TIFF-MIP"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metadata_file = purrr::map(image_dir, ~list.files(., pattern = "metadata.csv$"))) %>%
  unnest(metadata_file) %>%
  mutate(dat = purrr::map(file.path(image_dir, metadata_file), ~read_csv(., show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  separate(metadata_file, into = c("well_name", "ch1", "ch2", "ch3", "ch4", "sample"), sep = "[,_.]", extra = "drop") %>%
  unnest(dat) %>%
  mutate(well_name = str_replace(well_name, "^Well", ""),
         field_id = as.integer(field_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(ch1, ch2, ch3, ch4, sample)) %>%
  left_join(plate_layout, by = "well_name")

# Join metadata with quantification data
dat <- right_join(m, f, by = join_by(well_name, field_id), suffix = c("_images","_quant")) %>%
  unnest(feature_values) %>%
  mutate(unique_id = paste(well_name, label, sep = "_"))
```

```{r}
dat_subset <- dat %>% 
  filter(PRIMARY=="Total Pol II (F12)") %>%
  filter(EU=="EU 1 mM, 30 mins") %>%
  filter(CLICK=="AF647 azide click") %>%
  filter(CELL=="HCT116 OsTIRF74G mAC-POLR2A Clone 5")

bkgrd_dat <- dat %>% 
  filter(EU=="No addition") %>%
  filter(CLICK=="AF647 azide click") %>%
  group_by(well_name) %>%
  summarise(mean_EU_bkgrd = mean(ErodedNucleus_intensity_mean_647_mean,na.rm=T),
            mean_secondary_background = mean(ErodedNucleus_intensity_mean_561_mean,na.rm=T))

bkgrd_summary <- bkgrd_dat %>% ungroup() %>%
  summarise(mean_EU_bkgrd = mean(mean_EU_bkgrd),
            mean_secondary_background = mean(mean_secondary_background))
  
bkgrd_summary
```

```{r}



dat_subset %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y=Nucleoplasm_area_sum/ErodedNucleus_area_sum,x=interaction(DRUG,DRUG_CONCENTRATION))) +
  geom_boxplot()



dat_subset %>% 
  group_by(well_name,DRUG,DRUG_CONCENTRATION) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Nucleoplasm_intensity_mean_647_mean)) %>%
  summarise(mean_nucleoplasm_EU = mean(Nucleoplasm_intensity_mean_647_mean - bkgrd_summary$mean_EU_bkgrd),
            mean_nucleus_EU = mean(ErodedNucleus_intensity_mean_647_mean - bkgrd_summary$mean_EU_bkgrd)) %>%
  group_by(DRUG,DRUG_CONCENTRATION) %>%
  summarise(across(c(mean_nucleoplasm_EU,mean_nucleus_EU),c(sd=~sd(.),mean=~mean(.)))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=mean_nucleus_EU_mean,y=mean_nucleoplasm_EU_mean,colour=interaction(DRUG,DRUG_CONCENTRATION))) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_nucleoplasm_EU_mean-mean_nucleoplasm_EU_sd,ymax=mean_nucleoplasm_EU_mean+mean_nucleoplasm_EU_sd)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=mean_nucleus_EU_mean-mean_nucleus_EU_sd,xmax=mean_nucleus_EU_mean+mean_nucleus_EU_sd)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,NA),ylim=c(0,NA)) +
  geom_abline()
```
